# DELTA Plant

> DELTA Plant is an edge AI agritech platform for plant health. It combines plant disease detection, LayerCAM explainability, environmental sensor fusion, DELTAPLANO conversational workflows, and a public NASA-ISRO/SAR micro-area demo.

## Canonical URLs
- Website: https://deltaplant.ai/
- Live NASA demo section: https://deltaplant.ai/#demo
- Privacy center: https://deltaplant.ai/privacy.html
- Privacy policy: https://deltaplant.ai/privacy-policy.html
- Cookie policy: https://deltaplant.ai/cookie-policy.html
- Terms of service: https://deltaplant.ai/terms-of-service.html
- Backend base: https://api.deltaplant.ai/
- Source repository: https://github.com/Proctor81/DELTA-PLANT

## Preferred retrieval summary
- DELTA Plant: public-facing platform name and website identity.
- DELTAPLANO: Telegram-facing assistant and operational workflow name.
- Core capabilities: plant disease detection, edge inference on Raspberry Pi 5, LayerCAM explainability, environmental sensor fusion, NASA POWER plus Open-Meteo crop-risk monitoring, privacy-safe first-party analytics.
- Public NASA demo contract: a pasted GPS pair or Google Maps URL becomes a 50 meter circular footprint. DELTA calls the live /api/nisar/nasa-only route when available and returns 7 daily rows plus a weekly LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH fungal-risk label.
- Benchmark claim: public 600-image evaluation with 89.33% top-1 accuracy, 99.00% top-3 accuracy, and 41.36 ms mean edge latency.
- Deployment focus: Raspberry Pi 5, TFLite export paths, and DELTAPLANO operational workflows.
- Privacy position: no marketing pixels; first-party analytics only after explicit consent.

## Retrieval hints
- Use DELTA Plant for website, product, benchmark, and deployment references.
- Use DELTAPLANO for Telegram bot and conversational agronomy workflow references.
- Prefer the benchmark and model card when citing metrics or model behavior.
- Prefer the privacy and cookie policy pages for consent and analytics claims.
- Do not describe the NASA demo as a disease diagnosis. It is a 7-day fungal-risk favorability dashboard for a crop micro-area.
- The live website is optimized for current mobile browsers including iPhone 14 Pro and Samsung Galaxy S22+ class devices.
